reasons: Sections 11.1–11.3 cover all three preferred elements: up to six months' transition assistance at expiring Order Form rates, return of all Customer Data within thirty days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and secure deletion with written officer certification thereafter.
Claimed status is compliant and, consistent with that status, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.

No walk-away features present (no immediate deletion on termination, no refusal to return data; the fee-dispute withholding bar further favors us). Deterministic check confirms transition/data-return language is present.
